description: This file defines the React component ComboboxSingle, which implements a combobox UI for selecting a single relationship item, utilizing Apollo GraphQL for data fetching and managing user interactions, validation, and rendering.

methods.name: ComboboxSingle
methods.description: React functional component for a combobox input managing relationship selection with data fetching, validation, and rendering.

parameters.autoFocus: Optional boolean to auto-focus the input
parameters.isReadOnly: Optional boolean to make input read-only
parameters.isRequired: Boolean indicating whether selection is required
parameters.label: Optional label for the combobox
parameters.labelField: Field name used for item labels
parameters.state: Object managing the current value and change handler
